summary: Set the permissions of a user

200.description: true when the permissions were saved

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot manage users`.

description:
Sets the visibility and the access level (manage, view or hidden) of each section for a user; only the fields sent change. Access lists cannot be hidden while proxy hosts are visible, and certificates cannot be hidden while any host type is visible (400). Lowering a user's permissions lowers their API tokens at once.

Needs: a signed-in session of an administrator (API tokens are refused)
